notes.title: "MATCH APP!" Has Launched on Steam!
notes.notes: [p][b]"MATCH APP!" Has Officially Launched![/b][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that our visual novel, "[b]MATCH APP![/b]", is now available![/p][p]To celebrate our release, we're holding a [b]10% off launch sale[/b]. It's the perfect opportunity to experience "MATCH APP!"[/p][p]We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has shown interest in this game and to all those who contributed to its development. To those just discovering "MATCH APP!", we sincerely hope you enjoy your time with it![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p]Wishing you all a wonderful day![/p][p]Sincerely, TOX, Director[/p]

notes.title: 🎉Release Date Confirmed!🎉 "MATCH APP!" Release Date Announcement
notes.notes: [p]The visual novel, [b]"MATCH APP!"[/b], which is based on a dating app theme, is set to release on [b]Steam[/b] on [b]August 15, 2025[/b]![/p][p]It'll be priced at [b]4.99 (tax included)[/b]. To celebrate the launch, we'll also be running a [b]10% off sale for the first two weeks[/b]! Don't miss out![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Now Available! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the demo version of Match App! is now available on Steam![/p][p]This short demo lets you experience the beginning of the game, including the prologue and the first date.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Information[/b] [/p][p]Supported languages: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, English.  [/p][p]Please note: The English translation is currently provisional and will be significantly improved for the full release.[/p][p]Estimated playtime: Around 15 minutes[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this sneak peek into the world of Match App!  [/p][p]We'll be announcing the full release date very soon, so stay tuned![/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]
